truthPolicy: Only select a state from a reliable app, owner, system, or event-adapter signal. Opaque Agent work falls back to thinking or working.

lifecycle.name: Claw Tap Wait
lifecycle.trigger: a reliable external wait signal is active

lifecycle.name: Statue Pause
lifecycle.trigger: owner or runtime explicitly pauses work

lifecycle.name: Jar Click
lifecycle.trigger: owner completes a pending permission or answer

idleVariants.name: Claw Groom
idleVariants.trigger: weighted idle scheduler after quiet threshold

idleVariants.name: Leg Shuffle
idleVariants.trigger: weighted idle scheduler after quiet threshold

idleVariants.name: Drowsy Nod
idleVariants.trigger: weighted long-idle scheduler; disabled before away transition

aliases.reason: Morning Stretch already communicates energy returning without adding a charger prop.

selfDirected._policy: 宠物**自己**决定去做的事。与 idle 变体的区别不在观感，在**有没有目的**：擦爪是无聊时的抽动，溜达是它决定去别处看看。这些不声称任何 Agent 状态，所以不违反上面的 truthPolicy——它们根本不是状态，是宠物的行为。但正因如此，必须能被任何真实状态立刻打断：宠物的自娱自乐不能盖住「Claude 卡住了」。所以走 oneshot 插播，不占仲裁档位。
selfDirected.scheduling: 空闲且 energy > 0.35 时按概率触发，两次之间至少隔 selfActGapMs。累了就不折腾。

acts.name: Long Stretch
acts.action: Rises onto the back legs, pulls the whole body long, then settles.

acts.name: Upward Peek
acts.action: Tips its head back to look at something above the screen, then loses interest.
acts.designNote: 与 interaction.hover（Cursor Gaze）的区别是**谁发起的**：那个是你把光标移过去它才看，这个是它自己抬头。所以视线方向刻意朝**上**——不追光标，看的是别处。

acts.name: Little Wander
acts.action: Ambles a short distance sideways, four legs alternating, then stops.
acts.designNote: **必须真的位移**。原地走路是假的——退役掉的 moving（Sideways Scuttle）就是因为外壳从不发 shell.move，那个动作从没在屏幕上出现过。所以这里由计划带一个 drift，外壳在动作时长内把窗口平移过去。位移量取 64pt（约半个身位），够看出来又不会把桌宠甩到别处。
